variantrule.name: Sanity
entries: Sanity serves as a way to track how your character has been affected by the horrors and traumas of their adventure. Each character has a Sanity Maximum (SM) that is determined upon character creation and rarely changes. At any given time your character's Sanity Points (SP) may be anywhere between 1 and their maximum. This will fluctuate with some degree of frequency, depending on their surroundings and choices. In general, anything upsetting, disturbing, or traumatic will decrease SP (and may rarely decrease your SM), while relaxing, positive, and fun actions will refresh any missing SP (and may rarely raise your SM).
Each character's sanity maximum is the sum of their intelligence, wisdom, and charisma scores.

item.name: Heart and Soul
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with these magic weapons

entries.name: Empathy Link
entries: These weapons are a physical manifestation of the creators' love for you. If you hold one of them in your hand and focus on an emotion, you can communicate that emotion to the creator across any distance as long as you are on the same plane. Similarly, the creators both have amulets that allow them to communicate their emotions to you, via these weapons.

entries.name: Heart's Kiss
entries: Once per round when damaging a creature with Heart, if you have already damaged a creature with Soul you may trigger the following effect:
Heal {@dice 1d4} HP to yourself, and to another creature you can see within 30ft. Both of you also can add {@dice 1d4} to your next attack roll or saving throw.

entries.name: Soul's Reap
entries: Once per round when damaging a creature with Soul, if you have already damaged a creature with Heart you may trigger the following effect:

Deal {@damage 1d4} Psychic damage to the creature, and to another creature you can see within 30ft. Both creatures must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC: 8+PB+Ability Mod used to make this attack) or subtract {@dice 1d4} from their next attack roll or saving throw.

item.name: All-Purpose Toy
entries: While holding this tool, you gain a +1 bonus to the spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your artificer spells.

entries.name: Vers
entries: This simple massager can transform into a variety of tools or toys; as an action, you can touch the item and transform it into any type of artisan's tool of your choice (see the "Equipment" chapter in the *Player's Handbook* for a list of *{@item artisan's tools|XPHB}*), or into any appendage or orifice of a creature you are familiar with.

entries.name: Reproductive
entries: Every day this toy can generate up to 25GP worth of potion materials. At least 4 hours must be spent working to turn these materials into a potion, or part of a potion. Only one potion can be worked on in this fashion at a time, and the materials disapear if unused at the end of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}
